question: Which signalized junction causes the most total vehicle delay (in vehicle-seconds)? For each completed vehicle traversing a TLS incoming edge, compute delay = max(0, actual_traversal_time - free_flow_time). actual_traversal_time = last_seen_time - first_seen_time on that edge. free_flow_time = edge_length / edge_speed_limit. Sum delays across all completed vehicles per TLS. Only count vehicles present in tripinfo (completed trips). Answer format: <tls_id>
